notes: Italicized *these* folded onto πάντα as a resumptive pronoun under rule 103's stated contrast (3JN.1.13's *them* on Πολλά); reading it as a supplied object on ποιήσατε remains defensible and is noted in the unit.
ὅσα ἐάν joined only because the ASV writes a single *-soever* word (rules 50, 72); πάντα is anarthrous, so *all things* heads on *all* under rule 17.
